20.name: Blackrock Menace
desc: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
objectives: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
details: The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north. From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.
BHelp rid Lakeshire of this menace. Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.
BAnd although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge. If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
completion: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.

68.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.
objectives: Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.
details: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
completion: Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.

92.name: Redridge Goulash
desc: Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
objectives: Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
details: Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.
BJust bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
completion: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!

116.name: Dry Times
desc: Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager, a cask of Merlot, a bottle of Moonshine and a skin of Sweet Rum.
objectives: Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager, a cask of Merlot, a bottle of Moonshine and a skin of Sweet Rum.
details: I find myself in quite a pinch here, $N. The bottles are close to running dry. The latest booze shipment is long overdue. The orc invasion has been hell.
BPerhaps you can go to work for me?

BI need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
completion: A job well done, $N! I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor. But my patrons will be happy once again!
BMy wife is quite a seamstress. Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.

140.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
desc: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
objectives: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
details: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sander's treasure. The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text: Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure! Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore. Once ye get to the water, keep going! Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
completion: The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work. You force the chest open and take the booty.
BCongratulations!

164.name: Deliveries to Sven
desc: Deliver the supplies to Sven.
objectives: Deliver the supplies to Sven.
details: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.
BUnfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
completion: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.

188.name: Tiger Mastery
desc: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
objectives: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
details: Here is the final challenge that I will put forth. We've been tracking an elusive tiger for weeks. We call the beast Sin'Dall. See if you can do what no $r has done before: hunt down and kill Sin'Dall. Bring me her paw as proof of your accomplishment.
BTracking her down will be no easy task.
completion: Most impressive, I do say! You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, $N!

212.name: A Meal Served Cold
desc: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch, and return it to Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse.
objectives: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch, and return it to Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse.
details: One of my most famous dishes is Chilled Basilisk in Lime Vinaigrette. But the problem is... the meat is impossible to keep fresh, and I must serve the dish tonight for a noble's birthday!
BSo if you can bring me a Chilled Basilisk Haunch from a freshly-killed Cold Eye Basilisk, quickly, then I will owe you a king's feast!
BCold Eye Basilisks are known to roam along the beach dunes of northwestern Stranglethorn, so you have much traveling to do. And be swift!
completion: Ah, this will do nicely! Many, many thanks!
BNow if you'll excuse me, I must get the haunch chopped, marinated and garnished for the banquet.

284.name: The Search Continues
desc: Search for the Menethil Statuette.
objectives: Search for the Menethil Statuette.
details: You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.
BPerhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.
completion: This barrel is largely untouched. Prying it open...
B...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese. It's a little wet, but still tasty!

332.name: Wine Shop Advert
desc: Go to the Gallina Winery, and bring Suzetta Gallina the Wine Ticket for a free bottle of wine.
objectives: Go to the Gallina Winery, and bring Suzetta Gallina the Wine Ticket for a free bottle of wine.
details: If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in Stormwind. And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals.
BHere, take this pamphlet. Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir. You won't regret it!
completion: Ah, so you've seen Renato? Well here you are, $Gsir:ma'am;. A bottle of our special pinot noir. You'll not find its equal in all of Azeroth!

356.name: Rear Guard Patrol
desc: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.
objectives: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.
details: The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.
BOur success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.
BAssist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
completion: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.

380.name: Night Web's Hollow
desc: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.
objectives: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.
details: One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce even in the height of the Alliance's power.

BThere is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.
BGet up there and see what you can do for us, $n.
completion: Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.
BYou've done your duty well, $N, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.

404.name: A Putrid Task
desc: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
objectives: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
details: Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.
BGo there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find. Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
completion: Well done. I regret not being there to see you smash those undead into rotting pulp!

428.name: Lost Deathstalkers
desc: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
objectives: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
details: A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine. We have not heard from them.
BThey may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed. Find these Deathstalkers.
BTheir first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine. You should begin your search there.
completion: You found us! And not a moment too soon...

452.name: Pyrewood Ambush
desc: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
objectives: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
details: You got here just in the nick of time, $N!

BThe Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment. Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep. He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control. But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.
BI cannot handle them all by myself. I need you to help me. Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.
completion: You fought like a true disciple of the Dark Lady, $N. With the council dead, perhaps we can gain control of this town once and for all and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep. I salute you!

476.name: Gnarlpine Corruption
desc: Return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
objectives: Return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
details: The Gnarlpine tribe has been corrupted!

BThe once peaceful furbolgs have turned against the protectors of the forest. They ambushed me as I left for the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and proceeded to pillage Starbreeze Village. Ursal the Mauler, their chieftain, is using the evil powers of the Fel Moss to drive them mad.
BI am too wounded to return to Athridas to bring him this grave news. The task is left to you, young $c. We can only hope that the deranged Gnarlpines have not made it to Ban'ethil yet!
completion: By the stars! This is quite disturbing indeed!

500.name: Crushridge Bounty
desc: Gather 9 Dirty Knucklebones from Crushridge ogres in the Alterac Mountains. Bring them to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
objectives: Gather 9 Dirty Knucklebones from Crushridge ogres in the Alterac Mountains. Bring them to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
details: Crushridge ogres have dug an ogre mound up in the Alterac Mountains near the ruined city of Alterac. And my scouts tell me they've taken over those ruins as well.
BWe can't let them get cozy up there; if they think they're safe where they are, then their next step will be to move down into the foothills, which will put them right at our front door!
BGo north to the Alterac Mountains and hunt ogres. Bring me the Dirty Knucklebones they carry and you will earn a nice bounty.
completion: Very good, $N You must have hacked through a whole mess of ogres to get all these knucklebones.
BThat should keep them out of our hair. At least, for a while.

524.name: Elixir of Agony
desc: Place the Tainted Keg on the rug for the captured farmers.
objectives: Place the Tainted Keg on the rug for the captured farmers.
details: Next door the Deathguards are holding a few captured farmers hostage. High Executor Darthalia suspected one of the military strategists from Stormwind to be hiding out amongst them. Apparently the military chap was found dead in the Plaguelands last night. Darthalia, always looking out for me, decided the prisoners would be left to my disposal.
BI think it's time we threw those farmers a party. Sounds like a grand ol' time!
BPlace this tainted keg on the rug in their room. Plagued brew for all!
completion: You rest the tainted deg on the dusty rug.

572.name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
desc: Bring 10 Jungle Stalker Feathers to Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp.
objectives: Bring 10 Jungle Stalker Feathers to Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp.
details: The items you gathered from the feline beasts of the Vale are only the first requirement for a powerful enchanted item. These jungle trinkets combined with my shamanistic ritual will provide you with a very useful tool in assisting the Horde and the Warchief.

BBut now you must gather for me some Jungle Stalker Feathers. The feathers are traditionally worn by the beasts on their armbands. You will find a tribe of the raptors directly south of Grom'gol, not far from the great arena.
completion: Most excellent. I will prepare these at once.

596.name: Bloody Bone Necklaces
desc: Bring 25 Bloody Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
objectives: Bring 25 Bloody Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
details: I was sent to Grom'gol to aid Nimboya on his quest, but... I too have reasons for being here.
BThe Bloodscalp tribe is enemy to our tribe. Collecting trophies of our enemies gives us power over them. You may aid our tribe by hunting our enemies.
BThey dwell to the north. Slay Bloodscalp trolls and take from them their bloody bone necklaces. Collect many, and your reward will be great.
completion: Ah, very good. I will boil these, and leech them, and the spirits of their owners will weaken as I render their necklaces to paste!
BHere, $N. This will repay my debt to you.

644.name: Sigil of Trollbane
desc: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.
objectives: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.
details: The final of the sigils needed to unlock the tomb of Thoras Trollbane is held by his son personally. He resides deep within Stromgarde, in a chapel in the militia-held districts. Prince Galen is well protected and no slouch of a warrior himself, so this task could prove most difficult.
completion: Quite a day this is, $C. The blood of Trollbane will no longer haunt my people, and the sigils needed to take Trol'kalar are in our possession. Soon, very soon, we will strike against the hated trolls of Zul'Gurub.

668.name: Sunken Treasure
desc: Take the Elven Gems to Captain O'Breen.
objectives: Take the Elven Gems to Captain O'Breen.
details: Let's not leave Captain O'Breen waiting. He'll want to see these gems first hand. After all, that's why we're here!
BAnd after a few weeks of consorting with these pirates, the professor and I have realized the last thing that's good for our health is to be caught hanging on to their treasure.
BHere, $n, take these to O'Breen.
completion: So the little gnomes proved their worth after all? I knew we kept those ankle biters around for a reason!

692.name: The Lost Fragments
desc: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.
objectives: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.
details: The Scroll of Myzrael...the Scroll of Myzrael?! You don't want that! Its magic can pull Myzrael to the surface world and if you do that, we are in trouble!
BOr...maybe it's too late. Maybe she already is free. Maybe she's just gathering strength before unleashing herself upon us. If so, then you'll NEED the scroll!
B...too bad it's destroyed. Enraged elementals stole it and tore it up and now fight over the fragments.
BBut if you can gather those fragments, maybe we can fix it...
completion: Ah, you found them! Good work, $N! These might be the only chance we have against the evil of Myzrael!
BJust let me find my scrap-ratchet and see if I can re-attach these fragments...

716.name: Stone Is Better than Cloth
desc: Bring some Patterned Bronze Bracers to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
objectives: Bring some Patterned Bronze Bracers to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
details: I know how cheap Lotwil can be, $N, so let me make you something for all your troubles. Maybe it'll even help protect you from the coming atrocity that is Lotwil's newest invention.
BI've been working with all the extra stones you collected for him, and I can make some nice bracers that you might want to use. They're enchanted, of course.
BI'll just need patterned bronze bracers crafted by a blacksmith so I can complete the bracers I'm making for you.
completion: Here you go, $N. Try these on.

764.name: The Venture Co.
desc: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
details: This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.

BGreedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
completion: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.

788.name: Cutting Teeth
desc: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
objectives: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
details: The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.
BI believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
completion: Hmmm, not bad, $N. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.
BNonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.

812.name: Need for a Cure
desc: Find Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar and get the Venomtail Antidote. Then bring the antidote to Rhinag near the northwestern border of Durotar.
objectives: Find Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar and get the Venomtail Antidote. Then bring the antidote to Rhinag near the northwestern border of Durotar.
details: $N... your timing is perfect. I just hope I can compliment your haste as well.

BI was careless while fighting a few of the venomtails nearby, and one of them stung me deeply. I can feel its poison weakening me even as we speak. At this rate, I got maybe an hour left to live. But I'll need your help if I'm to do so...
BKor'ghan in Orgrimmar knows how to make the antidote. Find him... and hurry, $N. I won't be able to last much longer. He should be in the Cleft of Shadow.
completion: $N, you've saved my life. Thank you.

BPlease take this; I hope it can at least help you in your travels, if not bring you some coin. From what you say, I won't be usin' it anytime soon. Kor'ghan is gonna march me through more of his rituals until I prove myself. More killin' boars, more gatherin' scorpid tails... <sigh>

836.name: Rescue OOX-09/HL!
desc: Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
objectives: Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
details: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:

B"I need to move OOX-09/HL to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure. It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again. Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff! That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"
B"Escort it safely to the shore, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay! Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
completion: Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-09/HL! I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!
BPlease, take your choice of any of these items I have. Thank you again for your generous assistance $N, my robots and I are in your debt!

860.name: Sergra Darkthorn
desc: Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
objectives: Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
details: If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens. Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce. You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.
BSpeak with Sergra Darkthorn. She will be your first guide in the Barrens.

BSergra is at the Crossroads. To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks. And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
completion: You want to hunt in the Barrens?
BYour eyes are eager, and young. They're not yet squinted from tracking your prey across this land's dry plains.
BBut worry not. We'll toughen your body and your mind. And we'll teach you that there is more to hunting than finding and killing your quarry.
BPrepare yourself. Your journey begins. Now.

884.name: Owatanka
desc: Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
objectives: Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
details: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.
completion: The thunder lizard Owatanka is called Bluebolt by the tauren, for within him resides a speed that belies his size. It is said that lightning struck Bluebolt long ago and, fed from the sky's rage, the great beast's energy is without limit.
BMay his energy flow through you, $N. For you now keep pace with Owatanka.

932.name: Twisted Hatred
desc: Kill Lord Melenas and bring his head to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
objectives: Kill Lord Melenas and bring his head to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
details: I must warn you, $n, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.
BHe is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.
BYou must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
completion: With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. Thank you, $N.

956.name: Bashal'Aran
desc: Obtain the Ancient Moonstone Seal and bring it to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
objectives: Obtain the Ancient Moonstone Seal and bring it to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
details: If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.

BI feel strongly that this must be true, $n. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.
completion: It... it is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. Let us waste no time, $N. When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.

980.name: The New Springs
desc: Travel to Winterspring and speak with Donova Snowden.
objectives: Travel to Winterspring and speak with Donova Snowden.
details: Now, I've heard about other hot springs in a place called Winterspring, far to the north of here. The strange thing is, there are no volcanoes anywhere near them. Interesting, I know.
BWell, if you want to find out more, you should head to Winterspring and speak to a friend of mine. Her name is Donova Snowden, and she is currently staying by the hot springs there.
BThanks again for helping me with my thermometer! See you later!
completion: Hi there, $N. Yes, what Krakle told you is true...

1004.name: The New Frontier
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
details: Attention, heroes!

BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!
completion: Greetings, $C.

BI am pleased to see the likes of you taking an interest in the well being of nature; tales of your mighty deeds precede you, and you are welcomed here. Seeing you before me instills the feeling of confidence that the Cenarion Circle will get the proper aid it needs.
BOur connection with the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade transcends racial and political divides. Remember this as you work on behalf of the Circle, and you will do well.

1028.name: Raene's Cleansing
desc: Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant Dartol's Rod.
objectives: Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant Dartol's Rod.
details: Here is the completed rod, $N. Reconstructing it was simple... it's finding the shrine that has the power to recharge it that will be the hard part.
BWith some focus and effort it shouldn't be too hard for someone like you, who's already accomplished so much.
BHead southeast of here--there are very few paths, so be careful--and keep your eyes to the north. The shrine is hidden within the mountains that surround this glade.
BOnce there, place the rod within the shrine... the rest is magic. Hehe.
completion: After the glow dies, you can see the re-enchanted rod within the shrine's basin.

1052.name: Down the Scarlet Path
desc: Take Brother Anton's Letter of Commendation to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
objectives: Take Brother Anton's Letter of Commendation to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
details: We of the Scarlet Crusade lay claim to strongholds from Hearthglen to Tirisfal Glades. We are quite proud of our bastions of cleansing throughout Lordaeron.
BYou have proven yourself against the undead in Desolace. But the true threat of the plague lies in Lordaeron.

BTravel to the town of Southshore, in the Eastern Kingdoms. Seek out a crusader named Raleigh the Devout. Give him this letter of commendation bearing my seal and he will escort you to a place of honor in our Scarlet Monastery.
completion: Brother Anton still spreads the word of the Scarlet Crusade? Oh my....

1076.name: Devils in Westfall
desc: Bring Dust Devil Debris to Collin Mauren in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring Dust Devil Debris to Collin Mauren in Stormwind.
details: Ah, I think I have it. A messaging spell... I believe that's the effect he's looking for.
BI'll have to create a scroll with the spell impressed upon it. To do that I'll need debris from a dust devil.

BWhile I gather the rest of the components, why don't you head to Westfall and find one of the foul creatures? They are dangerous, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle if you're willing to subject yourself to one of Gaxim's experiments.
BI'll be here when you return.
completion: Allow me just a few moments and I shall have your scroll ready for you.

1100.name: Lonebrow's Journal
desc: Read Henrig Lonebrow's Journal.
objectives: Read Henrig Lonebrow's Journal.
details: You slowly open the weathered journal of Henrig Lonebrow....
completion: You say you found this journal on a deceased dwarf? Give me but a moment to peruse the pages...

1124.name: Wasteland
desc: Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.
objectives: Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.
details: West of Un'Goro Crater, via the northwestern ridge, is a harsh wasteland - Silithus. Few know that an ancient war was waged there between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror.

BSeek out Layo Starstrike, one of our agents in Silithus; look for him at Valor's Rest, the final resting spot for the fallen of the wastes. Give him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.
completion: Rabine sent you, did he? Well, consider yourself welcomed here... as much as this desolate and forsaken land can welcome someone.

BI wasn't alive during the time of the great tribulations that took place here, but there are parts of this desert that might as well be eerie pictures of that forgotten past. With your help, the Cenarion Circle might be able to bring finality to a threat that was supposed to have died generations ago.

1148.name: Parts of the Swarm
desc: Bring 1 Silithid Heart, 5 Silithid Talons, and 3 Intact Silithid Carapaces, to Korran at the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring 1 Silithid Heart, 5 Silithid Talons, and 3 Intact Silithid Carapaces, to Korran at the Crossroads.
details: You inspect the carapace carefully. As you turn it over in your hands you realize that the chitinous plating is interlaced in such a way that makes it incredibly strong. It's unlike anything you've ever seen. You inspect the rest of the corpse further and realize that these creatures are very powerful and highly evolved.
BLooking down at the carapace again, you think that Korran would enjoy studying more of these creatures. It could help him figure out what these creatures are, and where they come from.
completion: Ahh, you've seen Moktar recently? He always be lookin' out for me. I'm sorry to hear he spends his time watching over his little war band instead of seeing battle, but I'm sure he be takin' great joy in killing members of the Explorers' League.

BYou be smart to bring me these specimens, $N. Along with the eggs we be findin' in the Field of Giants, these should give me a good start in figuring out what these insects are, and what they be wantin'.

1172.name: The Brood of Onyxia
desc: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village wants you to destroy 5 Eggs of Onyxia.
objectives: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village wants you to destroy 5 Eggs of Onyxia.
details: Onyxia's brood has been scattered across the Dragonmurk. It is imperative that no more whelps be permitted to hatch.
BMake haste to Wyrmbog in the south of Dustwallow Marsh. Surely, she has made her lair there. Track down the evil dragon's eggs and destroy them.
BWe will never reclaim Stonemaul Village if the surrounding area remains a breeding ground.
BAs for Mok'Morokk... I have other plans for the sod.
completion: Splendid! It will be sometime before Onyxia can produce more eggs.
BOn behalf of my people, I thank you, $n.
BI have asked much of you so far. Perhaps you can do the Stonemaul Clan one last service.

BMok'Morokk is not fit to lead us. Tharg would make an excellent leader but is hindered by his injuries and age. Drive Mok'Morokk from this place by force. Only then can we appoint a new leader to return us to our proper home in the south.

1196.name: The Sacred Flame
desc: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
objectives: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
details: Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.
BI wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
completion: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.

1220.name: Captain Vimes
desc: Bring the Spy's Report to Captain Garran Vimes.
objectives: Bring the Spy's Report to Captain Garran Vimes.
details: Captain Vimes should see the orc report you found, $N. He knows the orcish language better than most. And he should know that there are Horde spies near Theramore!
BThe captain is in the barracks, on the northeastern side of Theramore Isle.
completion: A report from an orc spy! How did you find this? No matter -- let's see what it says...

1244.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Find the Defias Docket and return it to Watcher Backus in Duskwood.
objectives: Find the Defias Docket and return it to Watcher Backus in Duskwood.
details: Defias activity? Well, there's always some activity; even if they keep to themselves we consider them a threat.

BBut now that I think about it, there was a recent sighting that seemed odd. It must have been a couple weeks ago, but some of their agents had gathered around Addle's Stead. From the report, I'd guessed something big went down.
BWhy don't you check there first and bring me back anything you find?
BThe farmstead is south of the road from Westfall just as you enter Duskwood.
completion: You're back safe and sound. Couldn't ask for much more than that, could you?
BNow, let's see what we have here. This looks pretty official as far as any Defias documents I've seen. But it could be a dupe just to throw you off track of whatever it is you're looking for.

1268.name: Suspicious Hoofprints
desc: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
details: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
completion: Hoofprints... It could have been the quilboar, I suppose. Or maybe even the centaur. Their presence in the Barrens is not insignificant, and I would not think it a stretch to commit such an act.
BDid I tell you? It wasn't just that the inn was burned down... The owner's woman and pup were killed. Bad business, that.
BNonetheless, I will send Kagoro to find where the tracks lead.

1364.name: Mazen's Behest
desc: Retrieve Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence and deliver them to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.
objectives: Retrieve Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence and deliver them to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.
details: Master Mazen's directions were quite clear: Deliver a very important essay to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.
BBut I had never been to the Blasted Lands before! The journey was frightening!

BWhen I got to the Swamp of Sorrows, I made a wrong turn and ended up surrounded by horrible plant-like swamp creatures. They lurched as if to attack me so I ran. But in my haste I dropped the essay. One of the beasts took it I am sure.
BCould you please try to retrieve it and deliver it to Mahar Ba?
completion: Ah, most splendid!
BFor some time I had feared my request for Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence had been overlooked by Master Mazen of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences.
BHe must be bogged down with requests considering the many strange happenings going on.
BNow, if you'll excuse me, I need to begin my research at once. To finally glimpse the insight of one as great as Khadgar excites me to no end.

1388.name: Nothing But The Truth
desc: Give Faustin's Truth Serum to Deathstalker Zraedus at Beggar's Haunt.
objectives: Give Faustin's Truth Serum to Deathstalker Zraedus at Beggar's Haunt.
details: Everything is proceeding according to plan, $n. I want you to give this truth serum to Deathstalker Zraedus and he'll show you how to administer it.... properly.
BHaha!
completion: I knew old Faustin would come up with something good! You were a tremendous help, no doubt.
BNow let's get down to business, shall we?

1436.name: Alliance Relations
desc: Speak to Keldran in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Keldran in Orgrimmar.
details: The fight goes well, $N. Perhaps the Warchief will allow us to return to our homes before the seasons change if we continue to make such great strides in our battle against the demons and their underlings.

BReturn to Keldran and let him know what we have done. I am sure he will reward you for your efforts here. His cause is important to him, and he will take pride in knowing that the Warchief respects his concerns.
completion: You have returned from Desolace more than successful, $N. Thank you.

BThank you for your efforts, your time, and your understanding to my plea. Thrall understands and desires peace between the Horde and Alliance, and by taking measures to insure our appearance is acceptable, we will not provoke any further threats of unnecessary violence.
BI am indebted to you.

1484.name: The Corrupter
desc: Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
objectives: Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
details: This creature is far more dangerous than I had anticipated. No doubt Takata questions my abilities to take on such a creature, and it would insult his honor if he were not informed about what just happened.
BSpeak to the swordsman, tell him you are willing to slay the demon if he would allow it, but do not press too hard. It is better if he thinks it his own idea.
completion: I witnessed what just occurred with Maurin and the demon lord. That creature, even as an apparition, seems to have more power than my warlock companion. I wonder if he's up to the task of defeating the monster? It would serve the Warchief better if I go myself, but with my responsibilities here, I would disgrace my clan if I turned my back on my duties here to battle this evil for my own honor.

1508.name: Blind Cazul
desc: Speak with Zankaja in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Zankaja in Orgrimmar.
details: Hmm... But, of course, that is not why you have come to speak with me.
BIf Gan'rul has sent you to me, it must be that you are to summon a succubus, and need an object to use for enticement.
BHmm... If you trust a blind man to lead you, $n, then listen. In the bluffs of Orgrimmar, west of the wind rider tower, lives Zankaja. She waits for the return of her mate.
BGo to her.
completion: Have you come with news of Dogran? He was to have returned days ago, and I have heard nothing...

1532.name: Call of Air
desc: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
objectives: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
details: The winds of Kalimdor rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful $g brothers:sisters;. I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.
BThe element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.
BHead to the very south of the Barrens, and enter Thousand Needles. It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. She will teach you more.
completion: For the time being. I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.

1580.name: Electropellers
desc: Bring 12 Electropellers to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
objectives: Bring 12 Electropellers to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
details: We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, $N?

BOne night I was wandering the roads of Darkshore. I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine. My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone! I must have dropped them in the water!
BI need those electropellers! Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in Darkshore...
completion: I can't believe it! You found them! You are the best fisherman I've ever seen!
BThank you, $N. And here, take these. Although you're so good and you probably don't need them, they will help you with your fishing.

1652.name: The Tome of Valor
desc: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.
details: Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.
BHe'll send word to Ironforge to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.
BOh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.
completion: So, we meet again, $N, and you are in high spirits, I see.
BThe Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. Well done.
BDaphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property--and their very lives--was the least we could do for them.
BFor your valor, you will be rewarded.

1700.name: Grimand Elmore
desc: Bring Furen's Notes to Grimand Elmore.
objectives: Bring Furen's Notes to Grimand Elmore.
details: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and I need them sent to Grimand Elmore. He's here in the Dwarven District, in the weapon shop.
BAnd duck when you give these to him. He's fiercely proud of his skills, and won't like the idea of learning something from me...
completion: Furen wrote this? How dare he! Why, I taught him everything he knows! To think he could teach me something is outrageous! Outrageous!
BHm... but there is something in his notes that I'd like to try...

1796.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
desc: Bring Robes of the Arcana to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring Robes of the Arcana to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: The first item I will aid you in creating is a robe. You will gather the items for me, and we will put them together. Afterwards, assuming you succeed, you will have the first of many items that will make you more powerful and aid you in your struggles.

BTo start, you must have crafted Robes of Arcana. A tailor can make this for you, or perhaps you can purchase one from someone else--I'd be most impressed if you could make it yourself--but regardless, bring me the robes, and we shall go from there.
completion: This will do nicely, $N.

BAll magical items must begin with an item of high quality. The more effort and skill put into an item, the greater the magics it can hold. Rare and more expensive components hold the magic better. You will not regret having the robes fashioned into the ones we will make for you later on.

1820.name: Speak with Coleman
desc: Speak with Coleman Farthing.
objectives: Speak with Coleman Farthing.
details: You have proven your value to the Dark Lady, now perhaps you can prove yourself to one of her subjects.
BColeman Farthing awaits a warrior who is willing to be his instrument of revenge against the Forsaken's enemies.
BYou will find him in the Gallow's End Tavern in eastern Brill.
completion: Yes, it is true. I have need for your skills in combat. My means are small, but my task aids both me and the Forsaken's cause. Do it, and your reward will be twofold.

1844.name: Chimaeric Horn
desc: Bring a Galvanized Horn to Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Bring a Galvanized Horn to Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
details: I will make you the helm, but you must show me you are worthy of it.

BNestled in the northwestern reaches of the Stonetalon Mountains there lies the Charred Vale. It was once a verdant place, but is now defiled and ashen, and what creatures remain there are mad with pain and despair.
BThat place is where I send you, $N.
BYou must go to the Charred Vale and find a chimaera matriarch. Slay her, free her of her misery. Bring me her galvanized horn as proof, and I shall make for you the helm.
completion: You have completed your task, $N, and shown me your worth and resolve. The helm will be yours...

1940.name: Pristine Spider Silk
desc: Bring 8 Pristine Spider Silk to Wynne Larson in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring 8 Pristine Spider Silk to Wynne Larson in Stormwind.
details: Your service has been unwavering, $N. I think, perhaps, it is time you had a finer garment, one more suiting your station as an adept mage. If you gather the needed materials, then we will arrange the robe made.

BYou must enter Duskwood and hunt carrion recluse spiders. Extract their silk, but only the finest, most pristine silk will do. When you have enough, take it to Wynne Larson, here in the mage district at the Larson Clothiers. She will craft your robe.
completion: Nice specimens, these. I'll get right to work!

2204.name: Restoring the Necklace
desc: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
objectives: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
details: You are going to need to find some "oomph" for the necklace, and Uldaman is probably the best place for it, actually. I guess there are a lot of constructs running around in there, yeah? Well, take out the biggest, baddest construct in that place and grab its power source! I am pretty sure I can fuse that source into the necklace.
BWithout that power source, fixing the necklace will be impossible. Come back to me here to Ironforge when you have it, and we'll get it all fixed up for you!
completion: Well I'll be - I sure am glad to see you and this power source in one piece. It will take me a moment to magically fuse the power source with the necklace now that the gems have been reunited with it. Once it is done, however, the necklace will be yours!
BYou're excited, aren't you? All tingly with anticipation? Now where did I put that spell focus at...

2300.name: SI:7
desc: Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."
objectives: Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."$B
details: Renzik was looking for you, fish.
BI wouldn't keep Mathias's second in command waiting if I were you.$B
completion: Are you ready to get to work or do you need to take a nap before we get started?

2756.name: The Old Ways
desc: Bring four Steel Breastplates and four Steel Plate Helms to Aturk the Anvil in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring four Steel Breastplates and four Steel Plate Helms to Aturk the Anvil in Orgrimmar.$B
details: In the time of legends, Aturk would crush the skulls of his enemies and grind the bone into a fine powder for use in filament. Long gone are those days, $r. The Warchief calls for peace among the clans. Old enemies are now only watched with weary eyes!
BUnbelievable, I know, but such is the will of Thrall.
BEnough lamenting! You are here to learn, and learn you will! Bring me four steel breastplates and four steel helms and you will gain a taste of war!
completion: It seems you are but another complacent lemming of the Warchief, $N. How disappointing.
BHow I long for a glorious death upon the battlefield. Instead, I am stuck here, by order of Thrall, to teach infants how to craft! Watch and learn, child!

2852.name: Wild Leather Leggings
desc: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: With the basics down, you are ready to master more complex fare, $n. Wild Leather leggings are some of the sturdiest and powerful leather gear around. The waist, thighs, calves, and the vitals - all are given tremendous protection. Coupled with the enhancement that the wildvine provides, adventurers who own it will thank you each time they see you.
BFor this pattern, I need an order of two Turtle Scale helms, two Turtle Scale bracers, and two wildvines filled.
completion: Again, you've filled an order without flaw. Perhaps some day I will come to YOU seeking knowledge, eh $N?
BHere is the pattern for the leggings, along with my thanks. Commit this lore to your knowledge, and let your finished products tap into your impressive skills!

2876.name: Ship Schedules
desc: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.
objectives: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.
details: This scroll contains the schedules of shipments between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay. Both past and future shipments are included, along with ship names, with large 'X's next to some ships' journeys, and annotations like "GREAT LOOT" and "HARD FIGHT" next to others.
BSomeone at Steamwheedle Port would want to see this document.
completion: Oh my, this looks to be a list of ship departures and arrivals, with accurate dates and times and everything! If the captain of a pirate ship got his hands on this, he could have himself a field day!
BYou say you got this from a pirate? Well that's disturbing news...
BThank you, $N. I'm glad you took it from him, and I'm glad that pirate's eating dirt right now!

2924.name: Essential Artificials
desc: Bring 12 Essential Artificials to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 12 Essential Artificials to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
details: A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan. But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them! And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.
BPlease, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials. You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.
BThank you, $N, and please hurry!
completion: You got them! Now I can begin my new experiments!
BI can't thank you enough, $N! Your bravery has advanced gnomish research by a leap and a bound!

2948.name: Gnome Improvement
desc: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
details: Listen $n, that ring is yours, sure... but I can make you a better one! That design, like I said, is really simple. I am a lot more skilled now, and for the mere fee of thirty silver coins I'll spruce it up for you! Well, a little more than thirty, actually...

BI'm in a tight spot right now; all my material stock is all dried up. If you bring me a bar of silver and a moss agate, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will give it a little more pizzazz!
BTrust me!
completion: Ah, exactly what I needed! Someday, when I find myself out of this hole that I am unjustly in, I will make for you, for EVERYONE the finest trinkets in all of Azeroth! Until then, thanks for being a sport about the reagents. I'd normally charge ten times what I have charged you for a ring of this quality...
BSpeaking of rings, here's your new one!

2972.name: Doling Justice
desc: Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.
objectives: Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.
details: Out here in the wilderness, Kindal and I have meager means to reward your help, but we don't want you to feel unappreciated. Take my signet ring. If you ever find yourself in the boughs of Teldrassil, go to the Temple of the Moon in the heart of Darnassus. There you will find my High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. The ring will let her know that we are well and give credit to your story.
BWe both thank you, $N.
completion: That's an amazing story, $N. It pleases us that you've not only helped dragonkind, but also one of our own priestess. Jer'kai was right to send you to me. I will make sure she has her ring returned to her--I have scouts heading the direction of Feralas soon. This will be one more thing for them to investigate while on their mission.
BThank you again, and please, make yourself at home while you're here.

2996.name: Seeking Strahad
desc: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
objectives: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
details: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak. He is powerful even though he may be small. He can teach you about more powerful summonings--I feel you are ready. Go to him now. He is in Ratchet... above the port town next to his tower.
completion: A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... so much ignorance.
BIs that hatred I see in your eyes, $N? Good, we will put that to good use.

3092.name: Etched Note
desc: Read the Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Red Cloud Mesa.
objectives: Read the Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Red Cloud Mesa.
details: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the hunter trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.$B
completion: And it is my job to make sure you are prepared by teaching you the basics of our profession--how to tame your pet, how to fire your rifle, and many other skills that will become necessary.
BHunters are a strong part of our tradition and history, $N. You would do well to remember how important you are to the tribe. You will be respected and revered if you serve our people well.

3116.name: Simple Sigil
desc: Read the Simple Sigil and speak to Alyissia in Shadowglen.
objectives: Read the Simple Sigil and speak to Alyissia in Shadowglen.
details: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our warrior trainer, Alyissia. It seems Alyissia would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
completion: Soon you will see others from different races in the boughs of our home--do not let it cause any prejudice within you. They are welcome. They will aid us when they can. Not all of them will be altruistic, but they should be granted some amount of trust.

BBut none of this matters now. Now we must focus on you, and how you can aid our people. I am here for that very purpose. I will train you in the ways of a warrior as you become stronger. Return to me whenever you wish and I will do what I can to aid you.

3380.name: The Sunken Temple
desc: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.
objectives: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.
details: There are restless spirits in this world, $N. There are spirits that have been tainted by their isolation, bound to an ancient evil...
BI have heard of a place that lies deep below the surface of the earth -- banished there by powers greater than I have ever seen.

BIf you wish to learn more of this place; the Sunken Temple, seek out a goblin named Marvon Rivetseeker. He has studied many ancient areas of the world, and was last known to have left his home in Ratchet to study the troll ruins in Tanaris.
completion: Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?
BYou look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...

3452.name: The Flame's Casing
desc: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.
objectives: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.
details: We need one final piece to form the torch.

BIn the mountains to the northwest you will find a large encampment of Twilight's Hammer. It is rumored that they carry symbols and idols that pay homage to their god. These symbols and idols could carry sufficient enchantment to form a magical casing. Bring me a single symbol of Ragnaros and I will try to extract the magic from the item to create the casing.
completion: The symbol radiates foul magic; perfectly suited for our task.

3524.name: Washed Ashore
desc: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
objectives: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
details: Majestic sea creatures are known to launch themselves at the Darkshore coastline, beached there until they die. Lately, these beasts have been washing ashore in ever-increasing numbers. I've been sent here by the Temple of the Moon to investigate, but the presence of murlocs along the water has made my research difficult.
BThere is a giant creature washed ashore just south of Auberdine that is ringed by the foul Greymist murlocs. Could you go there and retrieve bones from the creature for our study?
completion: I hope the murloc did not give you much trouble in collecting this for us! I will be sure to get this on the next hippogryph to Darnassus. The Temple of the Moon has given me some funds to hand out for assistance; please have some with our thanks.
BYour success here emboldens me to offer you a chance to aid the Temple of the Moon further, if you are interested...

3764.name: Un'Goro Soil
desc: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Jenal at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
objectives: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Jenal at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
details: The soil of Un'Goro Crater is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities. I want to know facts from falsehoods; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough quality samples of soil for our continued study.

BYou may think that collection tasks are beneath you; that sort of attitude does not endear yourself to me or the Cenarion Circle. Bring the samples to Jenal, who is no doubt wasting time outside behind this tree; just look for the piles of dirt. He will handle the logistics - not I.
completion: Unload your precious cargo here, noble $C. It must have been quite the burden... not unlike the burden I carry being a visionary. Here is an honorarium for your work, as dictated by the Arch Druid himself.

BArch Druid Staghelm wants to speak with you again $N, but for his next task you will be aided if you have a journeyman's understanding of Herbalism. If you don't know it though, you will still be able to aid the Circle!

3788.name: Jonespyre's Request
desc: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: Excuse me, friend...

BA colleague of mine would like to speak with you about the research you are doing in conjunction with the Cenarion Circle. He is a druid by the name of Quintis Jonespyre, and he resides here in Feathermoon Stronghold. He would like to confer with you about morrowgrain... and he very much would like for you to keep our discussion from the ears of the Arch Druid.
BIf you're interested, speak with him; no doubt, all will be revealed once you do.
completion: I thank you for coming, weary traveler! Allow me to introduce myself - I am Quintis Jonespyre, druid and humble servant of Malfurion and the Cenarion Circle. My colleagues (General Shandris Feathermoon and the Protectorate - mayhap you've heard of us) and I wanted to talk with you about the work you are doing for Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
BBefore we get much further, I'd like to ask that our discussion stay between just us. If you have no problem with this, then we may proceed.

3884.name: Williden's Journal
desc: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
details: You have uncovered a mangled journal. Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein. If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the northern part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought higher ground from the savage beasts of the Crater once their base camps were overrun.
completion: Well look at this - my journal! I thought it was lost, much like almost everything else we brought into Un'Goro. I thank you kindly for returning this to me!

3908.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
desc: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
objectives: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
details: You see, I have no idea how I ended up here. No one really knows -- it's a secret to everybody! I just can't seem to remember anything...
BThese items you brought to me, though... I am remembering something.
BMy sword. I am supposed to strengthen it somehow, but I'm really not sure why. Sorry I can't tell you more, but I just don't remember!
BAnyhoo, I do know where you can take it -- Donova Snowden in Winterspring. You'll find her by the hot springs. She can temper the sword by the pools there.
completion: Well, of course I can temper this sword. While I'm working, you can explain what took Linken so long to get this to me. He's not usually one to forget things...

4004.name: The Princess Saved?
desc: Return to Thrall!
objectives: Return to Thrall!$B
details: You have slain my husband, $r! My child will be born into this world without a father.
B<Princess Moira points directly at you.>
BI assure you, this child will be the next ruler of the kingdom of Ironforge. You and your kind shall be hunted down until the end of days for this wrongful act.
B<You think that Princess Moira may be suffering from the residual effect of Thaurissan's spell.>
BLeave me be, $r. I am certain your warchief will be eager to hear the results of his meddling.$B
completion: <Thrall is taken aback by the information you have presented to him.>
BA new threat now looms on the horizon. As Magni's years dwindle down, the way shall be opened for this unborn Dark Iron to become ruler of Ironforge.
BYou have accomplished what I asked of you and for that, you shall be rewarded.
BNow leave me, $N! I must confer with Sylvanas and Cairne.

4124.name: The Missing Courier
desc: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: An associate of mine, Ginro Hearthkindle, is looking for assistance concerning the location of a courier and the parcels he was carrying. It has been a week or so since the courier went missing; our own searches have proved fruitless, and we're at an impasse. Unfortunately, I have had to declare the courier as missing in action.
BIf you have the time and resources to spare, please speak with Ginro. He should be here in the Stronghold - perhaps in his quarters.
completion: Latro sent you to me, I presume. While I think it is a lost cause at this point, I'll take whatever assistance you can offer. I must admit... I'll be glad once I can put my mind to rest on this matter. Every day I set out into the wilds of Feralas looking for signs of Raschal, and every night I have come back with nothing to show for my work save gnoll teeth and disappointment.

4148.name: Bloodpetal Zapper
completion: Looks like this is going to work perfectly, $N. Now remember, if you see any of those pests around, don't hesitate to use that zapper!

4244.name: Chasing A-Me 01
desc: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.
details: A little further investigation shows a panel that slides open. Clearly written above some wiring is the statement, "Replace Mithril Casing And Turn Power Off Then On."
BTaking a moment to replace the panel, you wonder if it'll be that simple to fix A-Me 01 and get her back to Karna Remtravel near Marshall's Refuge.
BOnly trying it will tell.
completion: You remove the panel from A-Me 01's back yet again and carefully remove the old mithril casing that seems to have burnt out. The new one slides into place easily. The only thing left to do, assuming the mithril casing was the problem, is to flip the switch to the "Off" position, and then back to the "On" position.

4292.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
desc: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
details: This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan. To the north of here, you will find a small trail into the mountains. It was here I saw Lar'korwi last. You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby. Take the meat you recovered and place it there. Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat. If both lures mingled together do not bring Lar'korwi to you, then I know nothing else that will.
completion: The Earth Mother be praised! You've done it! Fair play to you, $N. You have proven to be a great $C in your own right. Your spirit is strong. Your bravery unmatched. And your strength has been fortified. I bow down to your skills.
BOnly the greatest of my ancestors could have accomplished something so incredible. Congratulations.

4508.name: Calm Before the Storm
desc: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
objectives: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
details: My recent findings and the knowledge we have gained here today needs to reach hands that can quite possibly do something with it. As resourceful as we are here in Gadgetzan, we can't do this alone.

BTake my latest report back to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus; she's still at the Temple of the Moon, is she not? She's got friends who are Alliance bigwigs; if we can get them involved in this $N, then we just might make it out of this alive.
completion: While I genuinely appreciate this, I am not sure what good it will do us. The Alliance ignores threats from any source other than the Horde, and even our own leaders here in Darnassus cannot agree on what exactly this threat is. Fools like Fandral Staghelm theorize that the silithid are nothing like the threat from the ancient past I claim them to be. His ignorance is only surpassed by his arrogance.
BYou have seen the threat yourself, $N. We must remain committed to defeating the silithid!

4724.name: The Pack Mistress
desc: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
objectives: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
details: Some say the worg controlled by the Blackrock orcs are the creation of a supernatural force. Others say they are not true worg but instead a breed of demon dog, granted to the orcs by a fallen pit lord.

BThe truth is far less contrived but every bit as frightening. The worg of Blackrock come from Halycon and her mate. Halycon is the gigantic den mother of the worg. Her mate? Nobody has ever lived to tell the tale of that one.
BStrike at the heart of the worg. Destroy Halycon... and $N, watch your back.
completion: Rabid pups? Gizrul the Slavener? And you live to tell the tale?! Incredible! A tribute well earned!

4964.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
desc: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
objectives: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
details: I will get started immediately on crafting your orb and infusing your new demon into it. When done, you will have the choice of having it in the form of a staff or orb. I always felt it was important to cater to a warlock's chosen weapon... I see no reason not to continue that practice.
completion: It is done, $N. Simply tell me which you'd prefer: a staff that would require you to use both hands, or an orb so you may use a dagger or sword as your weapon.
BTackling a felhound was a great feat on your part. I am sure your item will serve you well in the future. Continue to work hard in the arts, $N. I will be awaiting details of your exploits.

5060.name: Locked Away
completion: The key taken from Farmer Dalson's ghoulish remains fits the lock perfectly. The doors of the cabinet swing open, revealing several items that remain intact and appear quite valuable.

5084.name: Falling to Corruption
desc: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
objectives: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
details: This greenish liquid... it reminds me a bit of the sludge I saw when traveling through Felwood. And I have seen some Winterfall Runners passing into Timbermaw... Perhaps these things have something to do with the flask you found, $N.

BThere is a large group of furbolg just past Timbermaw Hold, in Felwood. Called the Deadwood tribe, they have been corrupted and driven mad by the fel. Why don't you look around there and see if you can find any evidence of dealings between the Winterfall and the Deadwood?
completion: Inside the cauldron bubbles a rotting, repulsive-smelling substance...

5156.name: Verifying the Corruption
desc: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.
objectives: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.
details: To the north, along the east of the road in what's called Shatter Scar Vale, is an area where infernals were called down during the last great war--the craters still scar the land, as do the infernals themselves.

BI am curious about two things. First, are there still entropic elementals roaming the area? And second, are the craters still filled with the corrupt, fetid water that gathered there years ago? Will you help me and check, $N? Be careful though, the infernals destroy anything in their path.
completion: Good that you're alive, $N. Bad that the water still exists. I was hoping to find at least one pure source of water here in Felwood. It looks like my search has failed. The process of healing the land could have been made much easier with its existence.

BI will have to concern myself with saving what forest creatures I can while destroying those that have become so corrupt that they endanger themselves as much as travelers through this once-mighty forest.

5204.name: Retribution of the Light
desc: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
objectives: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
details: She would like to pretend that she's fine. She'd love for me to think that she's strong enough to deal with all of this on her own, but I know better than that. Trey's death and hearing the torture he was put through is going to haunt her for a long time, and there's nothing we can do to stop that. But we can give her some peace!
B$N, return to Shadow Hold, kill Trey's torturer and find his remains. There is no reason we can't tie off all these loose ends while Arko'narin mourns in her own private way.
completion: You gather the paladin's remains as carefully as you can, recalling that at least his spirit has been released from any pain or suffering that might have been forced upon him.

5228.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
desc: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: Within the lands of former Lordaeron are eight cauldrons - four in the west, and four more entrenched in the east. These cauldrons spew poisons into the air, propagating the plague throughout the land for the Scourge.

BThe necromantic might of Kel'Thuzad is too strong to outright shut down these cauldrons, but we think we might have a way to subvert them to our advantage. My second, Shadow Priestess Vandis, will be your point on this assignment; she'll continue the briefing from here.
completion: From the shadows, brother $R, I bid you greetings. I am to serve as your coordinator for our plan to sabotage the Scourge's cauldrons.

BOur goal will be to change the composition of the plague that the cauldrons create into something that negatively affects the Scourge. In order to affect this change, you will need to secure access to each of the four cauldrons here in the Western Plaguelands.
BThe time has come for you to lead the charge against the Scourge, hero.

5252.name: Remorseful Highborne
desc: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.
objectives: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.
details: The... the crystal...
BThe highborne here are clouded by their own misssery...

BI am sorrrrrowful, but I realize the errorrrr of what happened so long ago. Even though there is no waaaay to change the past, I am now at peacccce knowing that you have recovered the crystal of Zin-Malor...
BYouuu must return it...
BIt muuuussst be returrrned.
completion: Is that... what I think it is?

5636.name: Desperate Prayer
desc: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
details: Elune bless you, good $r. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.

BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
completion: I'm glad you've arrived, $N. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

5660.name: Touch of Weakness
desc: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
details: You be far from home, $c. You be needed there, back in your city under the ground. Your mistress, the one you be callin' Aelthalyste be needin' you back there. Like my tribe, there things you must learn only from her. Don't be stayin' here too long. You should be headin' to the War Quarter as fast as a zeppelin can carry you.
completion: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.

5804.name: Araj's Scarab
desc: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: Araj the Summoner lords over Andorhal from the ruined city's heart. We know that he was the former leader of Scholomance before claiming the city as his own. To finish the key, we will need his signet - called a scarab - mounted as the head of the key.
BMake your way into the heart of Andorhal, and break his hold on the city now that he is drawn into the open. Once destroyed, seize his scarab from his fallen phylactery!
BThe Key to Scholomance awaits, $N!
completion: Yes, this is it! I... again, I'm absolutely amazed at the depths of your cunning and bravery. It simply boggles the mind the lengths you are willing to go in order achieve victory.

BAllow me now to play my small part in this. I've prepared a special solvent that should allow me to secure the scarab on as the head of the key, infusing it with the power to breech the locked door of Scholomance.
BThis should take just a moment...

5924.name: Heeding the Call
desc: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
objectives: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
details: Excuse me, friend...

BIt has come to my attention that Mathrengyl Bearwalker has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. Mathrengyl is the direct assistant to the Arch Druid himself, and is one of the most sage and august druids you'll find in Teldrassil.
BHe is located in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus, on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree.
completion: I am glad you found your way here today. young $C. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

BInside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.
BReady yourself!

6068.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
objectives: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
BYou must see Thotar at Razor Hill. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
completion: Yes, it is time for you to begin your training.

6164.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
desc: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
objectives: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
details: I'm ready for business! What you do want?
BOh wait... I can't open up shop without my receipt book. How am I to keep track of things without my receipt book?
BI must have left it in town somewhere. I had a room in the inn... the book must be there.
BBring me my book. Please, bring it to me! Bring me my book and you'll see! I'll set up shop and you'll see that my prices are INSANE!
completion: There it is! And oh my! I forgot how full it was!
BThis is a glorious day, $N! Stupendous! Insanely good, I say!

6284.name: Arachnophobia
desc: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.
