objectives: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.
details: Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.
BBesseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.

BMaggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.
completion: Good hunting, $N! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.
B<Maggran rubs the wound caused by Besseleth.>
BPerhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.

6548.name: Avenge My Village
desc: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.
objectives: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.$B
details: The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.
B$N, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
B
completion: $N, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.

6644.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core

7028.name: Twisted Evils
desc: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
objectives: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
details: The crystal caverns of Terramok lie to the west, deep within Maraudon... It is an ancient place with much history. And I am looking to get my hands on some of it, $c. Relics of the old gods lie hidden behind the giant doors.
BIf you are willing to brave the twisted evils found in Maraudon, I believe I can make it worth your time. Collect the theradric crystal carvings you find, and return them to me.
BOnce I get the carvings, I will be able to... study them. These powers have been too long at rest...
completion: Ha ha ha! I knew you'd be back.
B<Willow mutters>
B...So easy to convince.
B...Will do anything for the right price. Heh heh heh...

7124.name: Capture a Mine
desc: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
details: As battle rages over the landscape of Alterac Valley, so too does it rage through the Coldtooth and Irondeep mines. Both are rich sources of minerals and both are used to store supplies; it's no wonder they are so highly valued!

BHelp our war effort, $N! Capture one of the mines for the Horde! To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When that is done, the mine will be ours and we'll send troops to protect it!
completion: You captured a mine! With our own warriors protecting it, it will be much simpler to extract minerals from its depths, or gather supplies that have been cached there.
BWell done, $N>. The deed you have done is a great boon to our battle efforts.

7172.name: The Eye of Command
details: It is good to see you again, $C. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf.
BYour time has come again, $N. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.
BPresent your insignia.
completion: It is you who must lead our troops to victory, Commander! The soldiers are under your command. They will follow your direct orders. Lead them.... Crush the Frostwolf.

7364.name: Gnomeregan Bounty
desc: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.
objectives: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in Alterac Valley.
BKill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.
details: The High Tinkerer himself has sent me to this field of battle to defend my gnomish brothers and sisters. We have received word that the tauren are singling out and slaying gnomes. Worst of all, they are removing tufts of glorious gnome hair from the corpses of the fallen. These atrocities must be stopped. We must reciprocate!
BI want them de-hoofed, $c. Bring me their hooves! Show yourself as an ally of the gnomes.

7484.name: Libram of Focus
desc: Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.

7508.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
desc: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.
objectives: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.
details: If you wish to take on this task, present Lydros with the dull blade.
completion: If you manage to enter the lair of the dragon, heat the blade under her fiery breath, and ultimately temper it in her blood, I shall bind the blade for your use.

items.name: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

7604.name: A Binding Contract
desc: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
objectives: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
details: The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to $g him:her; as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd.
BBy signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein.
BSignature
completion: It has been a pleasure doing business with you, $N!
BOn behalf of TB Ltd., I wish you luck in your search for Sulfuras!

7628.name: Doomsday Candle
desc: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
details: A Doomsday Candle stores fire and directs it at those who would disrupt your ritual. When creating your Circle of Greater Summoning, if your candle is lit then any wayward demons will be burned by its flames!
BContaining that fire is not easy, and requires the essence within the scales of a black dragon. Acquire those scales from a skinner and bring them to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
completion: Ah, very good. I'll need these to contain the fires of the candle. Now that I have the scales, I'll make the candle and hold onto it until you're ready to begin your ritual for the Circle of Greater Summoning.

7652.name: A Blue Light Bargain
completion: Aright, mister, I got a hot deal for ya.
BI'm lookin' to offload some of these here Imperial plate armor recipes and need someone willing to take on the burden. All I want in exchange is some thorium bars. Sound good?

7724.name: Fiery Menace!
desc: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.
objectives: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
BReturn to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.
details: Wouldn't ye know it, every time ol' Hansel wants to take a moment to relax and reflect upon his life, the powers that be give him another job.
BMe gots to think, come on! Ye know what I be saying? Come. On.
BSo, these here greater lava spiders are causin' a ruckus o' some sort. Oilfist says they shoot fire out their... erm, yea well, anyway, such things upset the children.
BI guess we gots to kill 'em. Rather, ye gots to kill 'em.
completion: <Hansel sneezes.>
BI think I'm gettin' a cold. Damn this frigid climate!

7820.name: A Donation of Wool
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7844.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
desc: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.
objectives: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
BYayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.
details: Three different tribes of trolls inhabit the Hinterlands, $N. That is about as far as the similarities between the tribes extends: We are all trolls and we live in the Hinterlands.
BThe Vilebranch - aptly named - are a depraved lot; feeding on other trolls and humanoids.
BIf Zul'jin were here, he would have destroyed the whole lot of them with a flick of his wrist - alas, Zul'jin has not yet returned and we are left to our own devices.
BIt is up to you to destroy the filth of the region!
completion: Well done, $C. Zul'jin himself could not have done a better job!

7868.name: Outrider Advanced Care Package
completion: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, $N. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.

BAs you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.

8060.name: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Wraps
desc: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists. They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies!
B<Al'tabim laughs wickedly.>
BIt is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness!
BFor you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power. For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.
completion: Impressive... could you feel the mojo flowing through them? The Paragons of Power were used as currency of sorts back when the Gurubashi Empire ruled these lands. Now we Zandalar will use the latent mojo inside of them to fight the second rise of the Blood God Hakkar!
BYou've done well today - consider yourself to have a friend in the Zandalar. For that, here are the illusionist's wraps I promised!

8108.name: Kezan's Taint
completion: It is only through our combined efforts that we will stop the Soulflayer.

8156.name: Arathi Basin Resources!
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
details: War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!
BThat is why Arathi Basin is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.
BThat is what I want from you, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
completion: You got the resources! Great job! I'll send the resources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.
BThank you, $N. Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.

8228.name: Could I get a Fishing Flier?

8252.name: The Siren's Coral
desc: Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.
objectives: Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.
details: Take a look around you. The ruins and beaches are overrun with spitelash. Recently, the wretched creatures have learned to recognize the rare components indigenous to Azshara.

BSpecifically, I speak of enchanted coral -- they are drawn to it by reasons unknown to me. Now there is little coral left in the bay, and it is vital to my research. I need you to separate some enchanted coral from the spitelash sirens and bring it to me.
completion: This is a superb specimen of coral, $N. Your skills are unquestionably precise and deadly.
BDo not think your efforts have gone unnoticed. Perhaps you are worthy of a true test of your skill...

8276.name: Taking Back Silithus
desc: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
objectives: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
details: Attention, champions of the Horde! There's a threat we've left unchallenged for too long. Tremors in the earth near silithid hives all around Azeroth have alerted us to large movements in their numbers as they prepare for expansion.
BCenarion Circle forces are gathering in Silithus to take the fight to the silithid before it's too late! No more shall they defile our lands!
BAll able-bodied combatants are to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold! The silithid shall be vanquished!
completion: Excellent, a new recruit answering the call to arms against the silithid. Welcome to Cenarion Hold, $C. I am pleased to see the words of our emissaries are reaching heroes of your caliber. You will find no shortage of opportunities to help us in our efforts here and I expect you'll quickly prove to be a valuable ally to our cause.

8300.name: More Resource Crates
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.

8348.name: Signet of the Dukes
desc: Bring the Abyssal Signet to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Bring the Abyssal Signet to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
details: Huum tells me you've figured out how to summon the Abyssal Dukes! That's quite an accomplishment.

BYou know what else would be quite the accomplishment? Smashing up one of those things really good. That'll cause an impression on their underlings, if you know what I mean. Bring back its signet as proof of the deed.
completion: I knew you were a tough $C the minute I saw you walk into Cenarion Hold. Keep it up!

8372.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest. There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature.
BThe forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack. Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens.
BDo your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, $N! For the Alliance!
completion: Well done, $N! You've served the Alliance well.

8396.name: Claiming Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent. Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy.
BWhat we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first.

BIf the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, $N.
completion: Good work, soldier! Keep it up and we'll have the Horde running all the way back to Orgrimmar.

8420.name: Hot and Itchy
desc: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.
objectives: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.
details: Maybe this sounds strange coming from an imp, but I'd like a pet of my own. I really would. It's just not fair that Niby gets me and I get nothing!

BIn fact, it doesn't even need to be a living pet. I'd need something to start making it with, like some felcloth. The satyrs here in Felwood sometimes have felcloth, so you'd just have to kill enough of them until you find some. That doesn't sound so bad, does it?
completion: Wow! You are too kind. Especially for a warlock!
B<Impsy holds the felcloth to his face.>
BOh how I love the feel of it, the way it burns your skin and weaves evil thoughts through the mind...

8492.name: The Alliance Needs Copper Bars!
desc: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: Hey there, $c, you look fit enough to contribute to the war effort! We need all of the help that we can get here to put together the materiel needed for the Ahn'Qiraj War and it's your lucky day.
BI'm collecting copper bars in stacks of twenty. It's for a worthy cause, what do you say? Do you think you could help out the Alliance?
completion: You did it, lad! We'll get those copper bars onto the pile and put them to good use making the war materiel right away. It's the efforts of people like you that make me proud to serve the Alliance. Good work, soldier!
BAnd if you should happen to come across more copper bars, make sure that they find their way to me.

8516.name: The Alliance Needs More Thick Leather!
desc: Bring 10 thick leather to Marta Finespindle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8540.name: Boots for the Guard
desc: Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

8588.name: The Horde Needs Heavy Leather!
desc: Bring 10 Heavy Leather to Skinner Jamani at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 10 Heavy Leather to Skinner Jamani at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: Since we're preparing for war, it might be best if we get all of the goods we need first, don't you think, mon? One of the staples of the war materiel that we're producing is heavy leather. We'll use it for just about everything, from reinforcement to armor, and good old plain tarps too.
BBut first we need to get our hands on more of it. That's your job, $c. Sharpen your knife and bring me back a bundle. Then we'll talk further.
completion: Simply amazing... look at the purity of these samples. Hmm, I wonder what it could mean. They seem to be elemental in nature, but... something more. They remind me of... of the Old Gods. We've found traces of them throughout Azeroth, and now I wonder if these creatures aren't related to them somehow.
BWe shall have to test further.

8612.name: The Horde Needs More Lean Wolf Steaks!
desc: Bring 20 Lean Wolf Steaks to Bloodguard Rawtar at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8636.name: Rumblerock the Elder
completion: The stuff of life is doomed to die and return to the earth, but the stuff of spirit lives eternal. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8660.name: Doomcaller's Footwraps
desc: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Clay Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

8684.name: Dreamseer the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8708.name: Mace of Unending Life
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
completion: You've done well, $C. This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect.
BTake your weapon, $N. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!

8756.name: The Qiraji Conqueror

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Rise, Qiraji Conqueror! Rise and be recognized!

8780.name: Armor Kits for the Field
desc: Bring 8 Rugged Armor Kits and 8 Heavy Armor Kits to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade Outpost near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.

8804.name: Desert Survival Kits
desc: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

8828.name: Winter's Presents
desc: Speak with Great-father Winter. He is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Great-father Winter. He is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
details: I hear Great-father Winter - with the generous support of Smokywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Orgrimmar. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.
BBut you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Great-father Winter has some presents with your name on them.
completion: Oh, ho hello there! You can only be here for one reason: to open your Winter Veil presents.
BNow, don't you worry, Greatfather Winter hasn't forgotten about his favorite $R $C. Look under the tree and you'll find your gifts.
BDuring this season of giving, perhaps your friends would also enjoy receiving some of Smokeywood Pasture's excellent products?

8900.name: Dearest Elenia,
desc: Deliver the Slightly Creased Note to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
objectives: Deliver the Slightly Creased Note to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
details: She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?
BBut after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.
BWhen I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.
completion: You wouldn't expect an orc to be so eloquent. Of course, we never really had a chance to know them before now. Thank you for bringing this to me.

8924.name: Hunting for Ectoplasm
desc: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands. Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands. Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
details: A fine piece of engineering, if I do say so myself! You will need to travel a bit, I'm afraid, in order to find the incorporeal undead we require.

BYou see, different climates lend different consistencies to the spectral fabric of the dead. The tortured night elves of Silithus, the spirits of the highborne from Winterspring and the ghosts and banshees of the Eastern Plaguelands should give us the different types of ectoplasm we need. Be sure to place the distiller nearby before you harvest them!
completion: Yes, these will do great!
BBy tapping into the otherworldly energies contained within these substances we'll be able to reach out to those whose souls haven't quite left this world yet!

8948.name: Anthion's Old Friend
desc: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.
objectives: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.
details: Theldren is not one to willingly participate in a fair fight. I've shaped this banner to display his family colors.
BWith some additional sorcery, this banner shall provoke him in a way he won't be able to resist.
BAn old acquaintance of mine named Falrin knows the exact procedure required. He has a particular way of... aggravating people. You shall find him at the library in Dire Maul.
completion: Anthion sent you, you say? I thought he was dead. I guess I've heard stranger things in my life.
BVery well, then. What is it you want me to do with this banner?

8996.name: Return to Bodley
desc: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: I will ignore your impertinence this time, $c, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, $r, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!
BReturn to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
completion: He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.
BThis is a great day, $N! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.
BThank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.

9020.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.
objectives: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.
BWe'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. But before that, let us see about your reward.

9044.name: Redemption Legguards
desc: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a pair of Redemption Legguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9068.name: Earthshatter Tunic
desc: Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make an Earthshatter Tunic if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

9092.name: Dreamwalker Girdle
desc: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Girdle if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 2 Cured Rugged Hides.

9116.name: Gloves of Faith
desc: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Gloves of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gloves, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps and 4 Mooncloth.

9188.name: Craftsman's Writ - Brightcloth Pants
desc: Deliver 6 Brightcloth Pants and the Craftsman's Writ - Brightcloth Pants - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9236.name: Icebane Breastplate
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 16 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 4 Essence of Water and 300 gold. You will also need to be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 16 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 4 Essence of Water and 300 gold. You will also need to be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.$B
details: Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace), I am now able to create an Icebane breastplate. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9260.name: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind
desc: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Stormwind and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Stormwind and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
details: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Stormwind from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

9332.name: Stealing Darnassus's Flame
desc: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
objectives: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
details: This flame, stolen from the shores of Teldrassil, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
completion: This fire aches of ancient sorrow, $N. You pulled this from the roots of Teldrassil, you say? Fascinating! Here is a reward for your skill. Return to me should you find anything else like this; I may have a use for it.

objectives: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in .
* Sturdy Lumber (12)
details: This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.

objectives: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
Should you misplace your :Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
details: It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.
Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.

objectives: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
* Crest of Lordaeron (item) (provided)

97220.name: Philmor's Favor
details: Every day this week we've been short dockhands.
Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
objectives: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
*Gatehouse Shipment (provided)
completion: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.

objectives: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
* Hissing Serum administered
* Hissing Serum (provided)
details: I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.
Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.
And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
